title: Davido Opens Up About 15 Years in Music, ‘ORIADÉ’ & Taking Afrobeats Back Home | Billboard News
summary: Davido celebrates 15 years in music and breaks down the vision behind his upcoming album ORIADÉ. He reflects on constantly creating, recording songs across two years and nearly 60 tour dates, and why this new era feels deeply personal. He also explains the meaning behind ORIADÉ, why he wanted the album’s title, theme and sound […]
